content: Double-proxy (NPM -> Traefik/k3s ingress): websockets need explicit Upgrade/Connection header support at NPM (per-host toggle) plus long read/send timeouts at BOTH layers; large uploads fail at whichever layer has smallest client_max_body_size/proxy-body-size (NPM default 100M-ish nginx defaults, ingress-nginx default 1m); X-Forwarded-Proto gets overwritten to http by inner hops causing redirect loops and wrong URLs; X-Forwarded-For chain must be trusted at ingress (set proxy protocol/trusted IPs) or apps see NPM IP. Outer timeouts must be >= inner. Sources: NPM GitHub issues 1556/5216/5374, authelia discussion 4627.
